result:
Both PRs are open. Budget is nearly exhausted, so I'll stop here with a final summary.

**PROJEXA PR #54** — https://github.com/FChecklist/projexa/pull/54
- Real PWA manifest (`src/app/manifest.ts`) + hand-written service worker (`public/sw.js`) for offline app-shell caching
- IndexedDB (idb-keyval) offline queue for work-progress entries, wired into `WorkProgressClient.tsx` with a visible "queued, will sync" panel and reconnect auto-sync
- `tsc` clean, `bun test src` 26/26 pass, production build succeeded and manifest/sw.js verified live via curl (200s, spec-valid JSON)
- Disclosed gap: photo blobs queue locally but aren't uploaded server-side — compliance-tracker has no photo storage column/endpoint, and building one was out of this task's declared scope
- E2E spec written but not executable right now — confirmed `projexa-ai.com/login` still serves compliance-tracker's login UI (pre-existing prod bug), so a real IndexedDB-backed unit test substitutes as proof

**compliance-tracker PR #598** — https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/598
- `updateIssue()` now rejects transitions to a completed status when a real predecessor relation is incomplete; `addIssueRelation()` rejects edges that would immediately violate an already-completed successor
- `tsc` clean, 7/7 new unit tests pass

Both are on separate branches with ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml entries registered, ready for their normal review/audit pipeline — no direct pushes to main. Full detail and disclosed gaps are in PROGRESS.md.
